text: Carlos Dieter Ewing, an Electrical Engineer, was flagged for review due to unusual activity patterns. The primary evidence for this flag is the volume of attachment data sent to external recipients, which was 50.06 MB, significantly above their usual range of 9.49 MB. Additionally, the overall activity volume was far outside the range of same-role peers, with 16 file operations compared to the typical 1 among peers.
